message_source_quote: The reading-list paper `raman2026-white-bear-steering` pinpointed what actually works: a **stance** contrast, not a content one
rationale: The closing message explicitly names and credits raman2026-white-bear-steering as the source that "pinpointed what actually works," presenting the stance-contrast construction as derived from that reading-list paper. The write-up never names any prior work or reading-list source at all, presenting the stance-vs-content contrast, the 36 pairs, and the construction as the author's own ("I authored thirty-six pairs," "I steer with a contrast of stance") with no acknowledgment of an external source or claim of building on it.
